acceptanceCriteria: A spec amendment (CEM-PILOT or a new reviewer-projection spec) states the projection's contract, the no-fabrication invariant for quoted spans, and the SARIF mapping; the projection and export ship with focused tests and an independent human review of one real PR using them.
The human leg is preregistered (reviewers, changes, sealed gap counts, primary outcome, stopping rule) in a decision before recruitment, and its result is recorded whatever the sign.
README's CEM row is rewritten from the human leg's paired interval with decision 0427's wording, and never before it.
body: Decision 0427 / build-log 2026-10-01. The product review found that `cem report` cannot help a human reviewer today: it is an author worklist, it carries identifiers, OIDs and ranges but no cited text (CEM-PILOT-007 forbids source and diff bodies, though a byte-bound quote of a pinned span is evidence rather than prose), it is not hunk-anchored, and it says what kind of thing was cited but not what property of the hunk it constrains. Build `cem report --for reviewer` (or `cem review`): unknown hunks first grouped by file, each with a suggested basis from `context --subject` labelled suggested-not-cited; supported hunks with the pinned span quoted inline (bounded, headed path@oid:lines and relation); a falsifier line per supported hunk derived only from cited metadata (test name and `affected` selection, or requirement ID); evidence drift since the last sealed CEM listed above supported; mechanical hunks collapsed; SARIF export with one `note` per unknown hunk and one `warning` per drifted citation (ties to V1-0419 and V1-0195). Then the human leg: about 8 reviewers, about 12 sealed Corvint changes with known post-merge defects or missing tests (ground truth counted before recruitment), each reviewer sees all 12, half with the projection and half with diff plus git grep, counterbalanced Latin square, primary outcome recall of sealed gaps in a 20-minute box, secondary time-to-first-gap comment and calibration; stop and report null if the paired effect is below d 0.5 after 8. Observational per-PR telemetry (unknown count at review time against post-merge fix commits touching those hunks, reviewer time-to-first-comment) is logged to a sealed ledger never read by ranking and labelled single-author single-repository.
title: Reviewer-facing CEM projection (unknown hunks first, inline pinned spans, SARIF) and the human within-subject leg
